data.narrative:
Isar Aerospace is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $650M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (including Sierra Space, Apex Space, and Varda Space Industries, valued between $1.1B and $8.0B) and 5 public Space & Aerospace benchmarks (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL trading at a median 27.4x price-to-sales).

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the $650M total raised proxy, implying $1.1B valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 6 same-sector comparables yields a $1.8B midpoint, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue figures, a limitation endemic to private company analysis. 

The two applicable methods triangulate to a median valuation of $1.4B, with a reasonable range of $939M to $2.1B. Key uncertainties center on revenue scale and gross margins relative to peers—particularly Sierra Space's outsized $8.0B valuation, which widens the peer distribution materially. Stage-progression methodology lags peer-based results, suggesting either underperformance relative to sector cohort or lower capital efficiency to date. Further diligence on unit economics and capital deployment efficiency would refine this range.
